items.title: De Meo: 'Kering Accademia per le Eccellenze parte, 85% della nostra produzione e in Italia'
items.summary: Kering CEO Luca de Meo opened the group's new artisan training academy in Milan (1,500 students, 40 programs across Bottega Veneta, Brioni, Gucci, Pomellato training centers) and stated that 85% of group production stays in Italy, directly pushing back on the 'Made in China' sneaker backlash and ruling out relocating production.

items.title: Gucci's new 'Made in China' sneaker models break with Italian tradition
items.summary: Gucci began selling Demna's debut 'Drip' sneaker (about GBP690/EUR800) and a slip-on leather model both labelled Made in China, a first for the house; analysts including Berenberg flagged tension between provenance and Gucci's luxury repositioning, with one Milan consultant quoted saying 'Made in China is not a good look.'

items.title: Forum Members Review the 'Vulgar' Gucci Spring 2027 Collection From Demna
items.summary: Roundup of fashion-forum member reactions to Demna's SS27 'Store Show' is overwhelmingly negative, with posters calling it 'pure vulgarity, paired with an absolute lack of vision,' 'a pile of nothingness,' and predicting it could be Demna's final season; one comment says the collection 'screams DSquared2.'

items.title: PurseForum Gucci Clubhouse ongoing SS27/Store Show and pricing discussion
items.summary: Active Gucci-dedicated forum thread hub where members continue discussing the SS27 'Store Show' collection, new bag styles, and recurring complaints about price-to-quality gap under Demna; engagement counts are not exposed by the forum's public view.

items.title: Dazed TikTok: Gucci Memoria exhibition at Milan Design Week
items.summary: Dazed's TikTok covers 'Gucci Memoria,' Demna's Milan Design Week exhibition tracing 105 years of Gucci history via Renaissance-style tapestries and a Flora-motif garden inside a historic monastery, tied to the 'La Famiglia' campaign characters; framed as heritage-forward counter-programming to the sneaker controversy.

items.title: Trustpilot Italia: recensioni negative su boutique Gucci Milano
items.summary: Recent Italian Trustpilot reviews describe the Gucci Monte Napoleone boutique as beautiful but with poor service toward customers not spending large sums, unprepared sales staff, and a durability complaint where a bag dried out within a few years with no store remedy offered; online orders also cited for damaged/empty packages.

items.title: Demna Gives A Lesson In Sex Education At Gucci Fall/Winter 2026
items.summary: Review of the Milan-presented FW26 show frames Demna's 1990s Tom Ford-era homage, tight silhouettes and Kate Moss's finale look (recreating the 1997 Gucci G-string) as a deliberate bid to restore erotic charge and cultural buzz to the house after the De Sarno years.

items.title: Kering-Aktie nachboerslich bei 35,41 Euro: minus 2,45 Prozent
items.summary: Kering shares slipped 2.45% in after-hours trading to EUR35.41 on 30 September, continuing a choppy month for the stock as investors weigh the Gucci sneaker-sourcing controversy against de Meo's reassurances on Italian manufacturing commitment.

items.title: Vogue Instagram video of Kate Moss's Gucci SS27 campaign look draws mixed comments
items.summary: An Instagram video posted by Vogue showing Kate Moss's backless gown from Demna's Primavera campaign/runway drew split public reaction: several commenters called her an 'icon,' while many others criticized the fit, with one writing the dress 'lines in the back fall in a way that's not flattering.'
